title: slot0 spot price used in OracleAdapter.getPrice enables single-block manipulation
root_cause: OracleAdapter.getPrice() reads pool.slot0().sqrtPriceX96 directly instead of a TWAP, so the price is manipulable within one block via a flash-loan swap.
attacker_entrypoint: Attacker contract: flash-loan -> swap to move slot0 -> call protocol function consuming getPrice() -> unwind.
attacker_capabilities: call any public function from an EOA

severity_justification.worst_case: Attacker borrows against an inflated price and leaves bad debt.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Attacker extracts ~5-12% of borrowable liquidity per manipulation depending on pool depth.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: Immunefi v2.2 — oracle manipulation leading to fund loss (High).

call_trace: swapExactInput to push slot0 sqrtPriceX96 up
swap back, repay flash loan, keep over-borrowed funds

state_transition.after: slot0.sqrtPriceX96 = P0 (restored); attacker holds over-borrowed funds vs collateral

asset_delta: Over-borrow of ~8% of pool borrowable liquidity in the modeled scenario.
reproduction_steps: Observe getPrice() returns the manipulated price mid-transaction
Assert attacker borrow exceeds honest-price collateral value
prior_audit_overlap: Solodit: several reported 'slot0 spot price' oracle findings on similar adapters; needs human comparison to confirm this instance is distinct.
false_positive_risks: If a downstream TWAP guard wraps getPrice() in the consuming contract, impact is reduced.
invalidating_conditions: Invalid if getPrice() actually returns a TWAP (observe()) rather than slot0.

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: getPrice() reads slot0 directly; no observe()/TWAP is used (contracts/OracleAdapter.sol:66).
No deviation check exists between slot0 and any reference price.

assumptions: A flash-loan source with sufficient liquidity exists for the manipulated token.
triager_summary: Well-proven slot0 oracle manipulation, but slot0 findings are extremely common and a possible duplicate was flagged. Route to a human to compare against prior reports before submitting.
